answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a stake in a shared vault before earning reputation: one identity is cheap, but each extra identity demands its own locked deposit, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand times more. Honest agents recover their stake over time, while proven fraud forfeits it, turning forgery from a free trick into a priced barrier as solid as timber. A violet-flagged audit trail then lets peers trace suspicious clusters back to the same funder.
